overloads.semanticRole: The JSON Validate command checks the compliance of the vJson JSON contents with the rules defined in the vSchema JSON schema.

constraints: Validation (checking vJson against the rules in vSchema) is distinct from well-formedness checking, which JSON Parse performs instead.

4D supports two JSON Schema Validation draft versions: 2020-12 (recommended; all vocabulary supported except contentEncoding/contentMediaType/contentSchema and $dynamicRef/$dynamicAnchor and https:... references) and version 4 (legacy, more limited).

The schema draft version is selected via the vSchema "$schema" key (e.g. "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema" or "http://json-schema.org/draft-04/schema#"); if $schema is omitted, version 4 is used for compatibility. An unrecognized $schema value raises an error.
If vSchema itself is not a valid JSON schema, 4D returns a Null object and throws an error catchable by an on error call method.
The returned object always has a success Boolean; when false, it also includes an errors collection of error objects.
